Listener restore SHA256 b9464f8b36b0a5a627d40d34f9f8e7fb4e26bac974d11496ddabb7a3a1faf169; guard restore SHA256 811e1ba3f48e5ab51bf301de04da698afe63c7f0ca3d370f9df2dc0c50e6db53. Matrix covers no/owner/other-device/malformed cookies, GET/POST plus HEAD, navigation headers present/absent, JSON and form submissions, full body bytes and every Fetch response header. Ordinary live rendering uses fixed nonce entropy for byte comparison. These are isolated local HTTP/store tests, not runtime ingress or R6 qualification.
